description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this beautiful home:* Short Walk from Sea Breeze Public Beach Access* Fabulous screened-in porch w/ seating* Community Pool just steps away (seasonally heated)* 4 Bikes Included* Just 1 mile to The Big Chill: restaurants, shops, and entertainment* Just minutes to Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, and Seaside* Snorkel the Grouper Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service**This property does not allow parties of adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions.***** there is construction being done on the pool until Dec 21, 2024****We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!The Magnolia Cottage is a charming 2 bedroom/2 bath home in the charming community of Magnolia Cottages by the Sea on Scenic Hwy 30A. Situated only 350 yards from Sea Breeze beach access and just minutes from Rosemary Beach, this stunning home has a modern kitchen with stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, hardwood floors, open style floor plan, and spacious bedrooms! Be sure to indulge in optimum relaxation on the large screened-in porch! With a full bed in the master, a full bed in the guest bedroom, and a sleeper sofa in the living room, this beautiful home can sleep 6 guests comfortably. This location has something for everyone, whether it be playing at the beach, visiting all the 30A attractions, or swimming at the gorgeous community pool! Enjoy lasting memories by making Magnolia Cottage your next beach vacation tradition!Families will love the amazing Magnolia Cottages by the Sea! This small community of Florida cottages is just across from Seacrest Beach on Scenic Hwy 30A. The location is ideal- about 1 mile from The Big Chill on 30A and minutes to Rosemary and Alys Beach! Seasonally heated community pool, Magnolia Cottages by the Sea is sure be the perfect peaceful beach vacation! Public beach access is 100 yards left or right from the private beach. Private is not available for guests.The Bed Setup: Master Bedroom: Full BedGuest Bedroom: Full BedLiving Room: Sleeper Sofa Area Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. “The Big Chill” is the incredible spot for dining and entertainment nearby. The Big Chill offers something for folks of all ages and tastes, from tacos and tequila, to wings, burgers and shakes, a stop here is quick, tasty and convenient, and comes with a side of entertainment at the outdoor amphitheater. It's a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
